actualIndependentSummary: Reviewed all four supplied PNGs, including the native 128px portrait and the sheets' native 1x and nearest 3x views on light, dark and checker backgrounds. The broad ivory mane, blue underside shadows, gold eye/collar and teal tail tip read consistently; upper-left highlights give the rump and mane volume. The body fills the cell, standing support paws share a ground line, and the collar, tail and attacking forepaw remain visibly connected. Windup lowers the mane, move widens the stride, attack opens the jaw and extends a paw, and recover retracts it. Skill contact shows two curved cyan gusts originating at the actual mouth; recovery closes the jaw and leaves three shards. Poison has drool and a lifted paw, stun has closed eyes/head changes and stars, and sleep folds the body down: these are distinct pose states rather than whole-body tints or unrelated attacks. Rework is recommended for the narrowly joined, flat-topped far foreleg, block-shaped folded sleep limbs, and weak visual separation of the charging core from ordinary mane shading. No conspicuous accidental interior transparent holes were visible across the three backgrounds, but diagonal connectivity does not establish convincing anatomy. These static pose previews cannot establish animation timing, playback continuity, actual battle grounding/contact, or the claimed authoring process. This recommendation is advisory; user selection remains separate.
